URL: https://schoolsweek.co.uk/gcse-results-day-2026-6-key-trends-from-this-years-data/
(Lead confirmed via BBC education coverage bbc.co.uk; figures cross-referenced across GCSE results-day reporting 21 Aug 2026)

GCSE results day — Thursday/Friday 21 August 2026 (England / UK):
- 22.0% of GCSE entries were awarded grade 7/A or above, compared with 21.9% in 2025.
- 67.3% achieved grade 4/C or above (the standard pass), down fractionally from 67.4% in 2025.
- 97.9% achieved at least grade 1/G.
- The pass rate at grade 4/C fell slightly for the third year running and is now level with
  2019 — meaning the return to pre-pandemic grading standards is effectively complete. 2026
  is a story of stability rather than significant change.
- Post-16 resits: for students aged 17+ retaking, 19.8% of English language entries achieved
  grade 4 or above (down from 20.9% in 2025); in maths the figure fell from 17.1% to 15.3%.
